caption: Certified, lanes B2.2 (G40, section 4) and A1.3 (zeta, fixed-window protocol). (a) The true counts N_k = Tr B^k against that prediction for k <= 16, and (b) the rescaled error nu_k, inside the band |nu_k| <= nu_0 = 78; both derived exactly from lane B2's printed prime-cycle counts pi(l), l <= 16 (checked against its printed nu_(K+1) and rho(K)).
